lines: A blind date sits at the wrong table [SCRAPE].
The actual reservation name gets called three times [AHEM AHEM AHEM].
A nail catches on borrowed sequins [SNAG].
The whole dance floor turns to look [GASP].
The cocktail mixer has a dramatic streak [SHAKA SHAKA].
It takes a bow and knocks over an ice bucket [CLONK].
A bouquet flies over the dance floor [FWISH].
It lands in an unattended plate of cake [SPLAT].
A glamorous spy sneaks through the lobby [TIP TAP].
Their borrowed jacket is full of loose change [JINGLE JINGLE].
The party photographer says look natural [CLICK].
Everyone immediately freezes [EEEE].
A single folding chair gives out [KERCHUNK].
The wedding singer hits the high note [AAAA].
The disco ball lowers to join the duet [WHIRR].
Someone puts a slow dance on the jukebox [KACHUNK].
The only couple on the floor is two Roombas [BZZ BZZ].
A dramatic breakup begins at a drive-through speaker [KSHHH].
The cashier asks if they'd like to make it a combo [BEEP].
A secret admirer slides a note under the door [SHFF].
The golden retriever intercepts it [CHOMP].
The admirer tries a doorbell instead [DING DONG].
